## [1.0.3](https://github.com/kuntal-devrat/diskwala-patches/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3) (2026-09-02)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **morphe:** preserve Hermes bundle replacements ([c8f0b9e](https://github.com/kuntal-devrat/diskwala-patches/commit/c8f0b9e586c403bf8401f8da91f5287a67195312))

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Stubs AppLovin, AdMob, InMobi and other ad SDKs at the bytecode level to prevent ads from loading without breaking the app.

patches.name: Disable forced update
patches.description: Bypasses PairIP license check ('Download from Play Store'), Play Integrity, and signature verification to allow modified and sideloaded app usage.

patches.name: Patch native libraries
patches.description: Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes RevenueCat entitlements appear active so ads-free and premium features are unlocked.
